prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1289; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the driver was changing lanes. Complaints centered on neck and low back pain with associated muscle tightness and reduced range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash, and the presentation fits the expected pattern for this type of impact. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. No prior injury to these body areas is known from the patient history reviewed at intake. Care included 15 visits consisting of manual therapy, targeted home exercise instruction, and as-needed analgesic management. Treatment followed a typical course, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and function returned. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported mild residual stiffness and was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
